description: This file defines the interface 'MenuLinkManagerInterface' for managing menu links in Drupal, including methods for rebuilding, deleting, adding, updating, resetting links, and querying link relationships.

classes.name: MenuLinkManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing menu links, supporting discovery, addition, removal, updating, and querying of menu link definitions.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Triggers discovery, save, and cleanup of discovered links.

methods.name: deleteLinksInMenu
methods.description: Deletes or resets all links within a specified menu.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes a single link definition from storage, optionally persisting deletion.

methods.name: loadLinksByRoute
methods.description: Loads multiple plugin instances based on route name and parameters.

methods.name: addDefinition
methods.description: Adds a new menu link definition to storage.

methods.name: updateDefinition
methods.description: Updates a menu link's definition without full rebuild.

methods.name: resetLink
methods.description: Resets a link's values based on discovery.

methods.name: countMenuLinks
methods.description: Counts total menu links, optionally filtered by menu name.

methods.name: getParentIds
methods.description: Loads all parent link IDs of a given menu link.

methods.name: getChildIds
methods.description: Loads all child link IDs of a given menu link.

methods.name: menuNameInUse
methods.description: Checks if any links use a specific menu name.

methods.name: resetDefinitions
methods.description: Resets local cache of definitions, mainly for testing.
